hydrostatic.model: 2D conservative well-balanced Euler-HLLC/Fourier/gravity with equilibrium UV EOS
limitations: Synthetic tiny closed-box compressible equilibrium research, not EEC550 field validation.
Fixed isothermal reference well balancing; no universal hydrostatic equilibrium preservation.
Common equilibrium velocity/temperature; no slip, phase rates, viscosity or turbulence.
Synthetic prescribed conductivity; no ground heat, release inlet, open boundary or terrain.
First-order reference-corrected HLLC; strong shocks and arbitrary moving contacts unvalidated.

heat_control_response.meaning: Prescribed synthetic stress coefficient, not industrial transport data.

gravity_control_response.meaning: Matched physical initial fields; gravitational potential convention adjusted. The initial pressure gradient is not balanced in zero gravity, so this is not a rest control.

one_dimensional.model: 1D conservative Euler/hllc/Fourier with equilibrium UV EOS
limitations: Synthetic periodic 1D thermal-acoustic case; no 2D gravity/atmosphere coupling.
Conduction coefficient is prescribed synthetic research input, not validated gas transport.
HLLC preserves stationary contacts; moving/general mixture interfaces may still create pressure errors. Rusanov is a more diffusive baseline.
Instantaneous equilibrium; no slip, phase rates, turbulence or field validation.
No viscous momentum exchange; Euler pressure flux provides conservative momentum coupling.
